content: SQLAlchemy 2.0 async people merge: the correct pattern is a series of UPDATE statements within a single async session transaction — no special merge API needed. Steps: (1) await session.execute(update(Utterance).where(Utterance.person_id == source_id).values(person_id=target_id)); (2) await session.execute(update(SpeakerAlias).where(SpeakerAlias.person_id == source_id).values(person_id=target_id)); (3) await session.execute(update(CaseAppearance).where(CaseAppearance.person_id == source_id).values(person_id=target_id)); (4) await session.execute(update(ArgumentParticipant).where(ArgumentParticipant.person_id == source_id).values(person_id=target_id)); (5) await session.execute(delete(Person).where(Person.id == source_id)); (6) await session.commit(). All in one async with session: block for atomicity. No new libraries needed — pure SQLAlchemy 2.0 async ORM DML.
